headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HUL (7)

summary: George Russell won the Austrian Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 1.9s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Oscar Piastri made the biggest climb, from P7 to P2.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P20.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.

The stewards penalised ALO (10 second time penalty), HAM (5 second time penalty), PER (5 second time penalty), ALB (5 second time penalty), NOR (5 second time penalty) and VER (10 second time penalty).
There were 45 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 81 points over Lando Norris.
